class nimbus.src.species_database.DataBase(data_file=None)[source]
Storage of physical properties. Information on the stored variables:

  • Surface tension [erg cm^-2] parameters in the form: surface_tension_A + surface_tension_B * T

  • solar_mmr: Expected mass mixing ratio at solar metalicity

  • solid_density: Density of the solid material [g/cm3]

  • monomer_radius: Radius of a single gas-phase molecule [cm]

  • molecular_weight: Mass of a single gas-phase molecule [g]

  • Vapor pressure [dyn/cm2] parameters in the form: pvap_prefactor * pvap_base**(pvap_A/T**2 + pvap_B/T + pvap_C + pvap_D*T + pvap_E*T**2 + pvap_F*T**2)

rgas = 83143000.0[source]
avog = 6.02e+23[source]
kb = 1.3811129568106312e-16[source]

vapor_pressures(species, temp, metalicity=1)[source]

Data according to Lee et al. 2018 (A&A 614, A126)

Parameters:

  • species – Name of species, see below for supported

  • temp – Temperature in Kelvin, can be float or array

  • metalicity – metalicity, optional (only used by few pvaps)
